Good to know

Questions, answered.

Can't find what you're looking for? Our team is reachable around the clock.

Ask on WhatsApp
Are you really open 24/7?+

Yes. Royal Fur is open Monday to Sunday, 24/7, with on-call and in-clinic veterinary support at any hour.

Do you have a pet ambulance?+

Yes — we run an emergency pet ambulance for fast, reliable response. Call +91 91477 36945.

Can tests be done at the clinic?+

Yes. We have an in-house pathology lab for accurate diagnostics, and a fully equipped operation theatre for surgery.

Do you offer services at home?+

Yes — our Home & Additional Services bring care to your doorstep. Message us on WhatsApp to arrange a visit.

What else is available besides vet care?+

Grooming by certified groomers, a pet supplies retail store, a supervised pet creche for day stays, and pet training for behaviour, obedience and social skills.

Where is the clinic?+

72 Gunamani Safui Road, Prince Anwar Shah Connector, Kolkata 700078 — near Avishkta, opposite Reliance Digital.
